about: SCION 28 trace. Per scene frame, measured from the render: x_screen/y_screen = centroid of the visible dog matte (after holdouts); x_measured_m = that centroid mapped back through the locked camera to the score metres (+0.45 m offset: the score x is the rear); height_px from the matte; facing = where the head points (door/away), body_facing = the body plate; state = segmented by onsets detected in these measurements (see onsets). x_score is the score value that drove the root track.
